invalid_answers: Please check your answers and try again.
submission_failed: Something went wrong submitting your application. We've saved your answers and are looking into it. There's no need to resubmit.
invalid_email: {label} doesn't look like a valid email address.
email_already_registered: That email address can't be used.
email_already_invited: That email has already been invited to the server. Check your inbox for the invite email.
application_already_pending: Your application was already received and is likely still pending review. You'll receive an email after it's been reviewed. If you have any urgent questions or concerns in the meantime, email us at {contact_email}
rate_limited: Too many submissions recently. Please wait before trying again.
server_busy: The server is busy right now. Please try again in a moment.
admin_application_held: An application from {email} failed to process due to a technical issue and has been held locally. It will be retried automatically, or run check_pending_applications.py to retry now.
admin_pending_check_partial_failure: The daily pending-application check failed for {failed_count} of {total_count} email(s). Check the server logs for details.
admin_pending_check_crashed: The daily pending-application check crashed before finishing. Check the server logs for details.
admin_held_applications_still_failing: {count} held application(s) still couldn't be delivered. Check the server logs for details.
